newsitem.title: USA: Transamerica Corp Q4 earnings summary.
newsitem.headline: Transamerica Corp Q4 earnings summary.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTES: Q4 1996 net income included $0.11 a share ($7.3 million) of investment gains. Q4 1995 net income includes $0.02 a share ($1.0 million) from investment gains, while special items reduced earnings by $0.14 a share ($9.5 million).
Investment gains in 1996 were $0.38 a share ($25.5 million) vs $0.50 a share ($34.4 million) in 1995.

For fiscal 1996, income from operations (excluding investment transactions and the effect of special items) was $6.20 a share ($429.9 million) compared with $6.05 a share ($434.2 million) in 1995 on a comparable basis.
